```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
library(dplyr); library(tidyr);library(knitr);library(here)
rm(list=ls())
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# UPDATE - Manually set park, climate future, and regional objects
SiteID <- "ISRO"
LongName <- "Isle Royale National Park"
CF_selected <- "WarmWet_HotDry"
# CF_selected <- "WarmDry_HotWet"
region.name <- "Midwest"

# UPDATE - Manually set directories (likely only need to change the drive [e.g., C:])
OutDir <- paste0("E:/RCF_2024/RCF_opened/", SiteID)

Park_CF_Dir <- paste0("E:/RCF_2024/RCF_opened/", SiteID)

HistDir <- paste0("E:/RCF_2024/RCF_opened/", SiteID, "/input-data")

# Read in RData file
load(paste0(Park_CF_Dir, "/input-data/Final_Environment.RData"))

# Read in Historical file
Historical_regression <- read.csv(paste0(HistDir, "/", SiteID, "_historical.csv"))

if(CF_selected == "WarmWet_HotDry") {
  CFs = c("Warm Wet", "Hot Dry") # Pick pair of climate futures.
  CF_abbreviation <- "WW-HD"
  CFDir = paste0(Park_CF_Dir,"/WarmWet_HotDry/") # for .csv's
  col <- c("#2B83BA","#D7191C") 
  color.names <- c("blue","red")
} else{
  CFs = c("Warm Dry", "Hot Wet")  # Pick pair of climate futures.
  CF_abbreviation <- "WD-HW"
  CFDir = paste0(Park_CF_Dir,"/WarmDry_HotWet/") # for .csv's
  col <- c("#FDAE61","#ABDDA4")
  color.names <- c("orange","green")
}
TableDir = paste0(CFDir,"tables/") # for .csv's
FigDir = paste0(CFDir,"figures/") # for .csv's

D_Annual <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(xlsxFile=paste0(TableDir,SiteID,"_",CF_abbreviation,"_Plot_data.xlsx"),sheet="D_Annual")
AnnualWB <- read.csv(paste0(TableDir,"WB-Annual.csv")) |> 
  left_join(WB_GCMs,by="GCM") |> 
  mutate(sum_d.in = sum_d.mm/ 25.4,
         sum_aet.in = sum_aet.mm / 25.4)
AnnualWB <- AnnualWB |> 
  replace_na(list(CF = "Historical")) |> 
  mutate(CF = factor(CF, levels=c("Historical",CFs)))
Drought.char <- read.csv(paste0(TableDir, "Drought_characteristics.csv"))

#Precip quad direction - saves in-line code
CF1_precip_direction <- if(D_Annual$PrcpIn[2] > 0) {"pos"} else {"neg"}
CF2_precip_direction <- if(D_Annual$PrcpIn[3] > 0) {"pos"} else {"neg"}

#Monthly trends
CF1_precip_inc_direction <- Season_delta |> filter(CF == CFs[1],
                                                   PrcpIn > 0) |> 
  dplyr::select(season)  
CF1_precip_inc_direction <- as.character(CF1_precip_inc_direction$season)
CF1_precip_inc_direction <- if(length(CF1_precip_inc_direction)==4) {"all"} else{CF1_precip_inc_direction}

CF2_precip_inc_direction <- Season_delta |> filter(CF == CFs[2],
                                                   PrcpIn > 0) |> 
  dplyr::select(season)

CF2_precip_inc_direction <- as.character(CF2_precip_inc_direction$season)
CF2_precip_inc_direction <- if(length(CF2_precip_inc_direction)==4) {"all"} else{CF2_precip_inc_direction}


#Translation text

# Historical -- look at state climate summary and fill in reference.

State_summary_statement <- "Temperatures in Virginia have risen more than 1.5 °F since the beginning of the 20th century and total annual precipitation shows a small upward trend, with multiyear values mostly above average since 1995 (Runkle et al. 2022)."

State_summary_reference <- "Runkle, J., K.E. Kunkel, L.E. Stevens, S.M. Champion, B.C. Stewart, R. Frankson, W. Sweet, and S. Rayne, 2022: Virginia State Climate Summary 2022. NOAA Technical Report NESDIS 150-VA. NOAA/NESDIS, Silver Spring, MD, 5 pp."
```

```{r generate-slides, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
fig_files <- list.files(FigDir, pattern = "\\.(png|jpg|jpeg|tif|tiff|gif|bmp|svg)$", full.names = TRUE,
                        ignore.case = TRUE)
fig_files <- fig_files[order(tolower(basename(fig_files)))]

map_path <- file.path(here("climate-metric-title.csv"))
title_map <- NULL
if(file.exists(map_path)) {
  df_map <- read.csv(map_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df_map$file <- tolower(df_map$file)
  title_map <- setNames(df_map$title, df_map$file)
  }

for (fig in fig_files) {
  base <- basename(fig)
  key <- tolower(base)
  
  fallback <- tools::toTitleCase(gsub("[-_]+", " ", tools::file_path_sans_ext(base)))
  slide_title <- if (!is.null(title_map) && !is.na(title_map[key])) title_map[key] else fallback
  
  # fig_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(fig))
  fig2 <- gsub("\\\\", "/", normalizePath(fig, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE))

  cat("## ", slide_title, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("insert text\n\n")
  cat("![](", fig2, "){width=100%}\n\n", sep = "")
}
```
